# ECN-2026-017 - Change notice - Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3

Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P3, line P3-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L2-HT03

Reason for change
- Background: Routine review of heat treat process control for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P3-L2-HT03) identified that the documented austenitizing setpoint in maintenance and operating records did not match the furnace controller setpoint. The discrepancy was discovered during a process audit and corroborated by cross-checking operator logs and controller history.
- Purpose: Align documented procedure and maintenance documentation with the verified process setpoint to eliminate ambiguity, prevent unintended parameter changes, and ensure consistent metallurgical results for downstream ring rolling operations.
- Change summary: The austenitizing setpoint for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P3-L2-HT03) is 870 °C. This ECN standardizes that value across the equipment controller, the preventive maintenance package, and the standard operating procedure references cited below.

Affected items
- All copies of the preventive maintenance document for EQ-P3-L2-HT03: MM-P3-L2-HT03 will be updated to reflect the specified austenitizing setpoint.
- The specific service procedure supplement MM-P3-L2-HT03-S3 will be revised to include verification steps that confirm controller setpoint matches the documented austenitizing setpoint prior to any production heat cycle.
- The standard operating procedure SOP-P3-L2-02 will be revised to include a mandatory pre-heat checklist line that references verification of the austenitizing setpoint for EQ-P3-L2-HT03.
- Operator training records and shift handover logs that reference austenitizing conditions for EQ-P3-L2-HT03 must be reviewed and updated to reflect the approved setpoint.
- Historical furnace run records where the documented setpoint differs from the approved setpoint will be flagged for metallurgical review as part of the implementation.

Implementation
- Documentation updates: Revise MM-P3-L2-HT03, MM-P3-L2-HT03-S3, and SOP-P3-L2-02 to include the confirmed austenitizing setpoint for EQ-P3-L2-HT03 as 870 °C and the verification steps described below. The revised documents will be issued through document control and placed on the plant document server with controlled revision status.
- Controller verification: Technicians will compare the controller display and configuration for EQ-P3-L2-HT03 to the documented austenitizing setpoint. If the controller does not read the specified austenitizing setpoint for EQ-P3-L2-HT03, the technician will follow MM-P3-L2-HT03-S3 to locate and correct the discrepancy before release for production.
- SOP sequence addition: SOP-P3-L2-02 will be modified to include a pre-heat verification step requiring the operator to confirm that the controller setpoint for EQ-P3-L2-HT03 equals the documented austenitizing setpoint. Operators will initial and date the pre-heat checklist entry to provide an auditable record.
- Training and communication: All operators and maintenance personnel assigned to line P3-L2 and EQ-P3-L2-HT03 will receive a briefing on the change. The briefing will cover background, the revised verification step in SOP-P3-L2-02, and how to use MM-P3-L2-HT03-S3 to reconcile controller/document discrepancies.
- Nonconformance handling: Any production heat cycles on EQ-P3-L2-HT03 performed with a controller setpoint that does not match the documented austenitizing setpoint will be documented as a process deviation. Affected batches will be quarantined and referred to metallurgical engineering for disposition, using the process referenced in MM-P3-L2-HT03.
- Examples: Example documentation entries will be included in MM-P3-L2-HT03-S3 showing a completed pre-heat verification for EQ-P3-L2-HT03 where the operator initials the checklist and records the controller readout value as matching the documented austenitizing setpoint of 870 °C.
- Records to keep: Maintain the following records in the equipment file for EQ-P3-L2-HT03: the ECN form for ECN-2026-017, the revised MM-P3-L2-HT03, the revised MM-P3-L2-HT03-S3, the revised SOP-P3-L2-02 excerpt, completed pre-heat checklists for EQ-P3-L2-HT03 showing verification of the austenitizing setpoint, any controller configuration printouts used during verification, training acknowledgment forms for operators and maintenance personnel, and a log of any deviations discovered and their dispositions.

Approvals
- Authorization: This change is approved for implementation in plant P3, line P3-L2 for EQ-P3-L2-HT03. Implementation must follow the revision and issuance process in the document control system and include updates to MM-P3-L2-HT03, MM-P3-L2-HT03-S3, and SOP-P3-L2-02 as cited.
- Approver responsibilities: Approvers will confirm that the documentation updates correctly reference the austenitizing setpoint for EQ-P3-L2-HT03 and that the implementation actions listed under Implementation have been completed. Approvers will ensure that training acknowledgments and pre-heat verification records are present in the equipment file prior to releasing the revised procedures for production use.
- Record retention: All records generated as part of this ECN will be retained in the equipment file for EQ-P3-L2-HT03 and available for audit in accordance with plant P3 record retention practice and the document control requirements referenced in MM-P3-L2-HT03.
- Related documents: See MM-P3-L2-HT03, MM-P3-L2-HT03-S3, and SOP-P3-L2-02 for the procedural details and forms to be used in implementation.

Prepared by: Engineering Change Control  
For inquiries related to this ECN, contact the document owner listed in MM-P3-L2-HT03.
